periods.time: vol-11 ch-002 final exchange of the championship

name.zh: 一辉跨越命运以追影击败史黛菈
name.en: Ikki transcends fate and defeats Stella with Oikage

periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome lava field and central platform
periods.summary: During the count, Ikki experiences his fate as black chains in a dark cavern. His love for Stella and refusal to let another rival become her strongest break the chains, causing his magic to increase beyond its fixed limit. He returns at nine with renewed blue light, shocking spectators and experts. Stella responds by pushing Dragon Spirit into a star-like heat armor that can erase Intetsu on contact. In the final charge, Ikki uses Ittou Rasetsu and a sheathless draw-sword method, first deflecting Laevateinn with Intetsu's handle and then cutting faster than his own shadow can follow: the final secret sword Oikage. Stella loses Dragon Spirit from heat exhaustion, vows not to lose next time, and collapses into Ikki's arms as he is declared champion.
periods.cause: Ikki refuses a respectable defeat because his desire to stand as Stella's strongest is stronger than his predetermined limits.
periods.outcome: Ikki becomes winner of the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival and a newly awakened existence outside ordinary fate; Stella becomes runner-up after an equally total battle.
periods.significance: The volume's decisive event: Ikki becomes Seven Stars Sword King, crosses into the realm of 'Desperado/Majin' by increasing his magic, and creates Oikage as the final form of his sword path.
